name: Teamworks Summer Camp (Warwick)
description_short: A weekly day camp at Teamworks indoor sports center in Warwick, RI, with a general camp for ages 4-14 (sports, games, arts & crafts) and sport-specific camps for ages 4-15. Regular hours are 9am-3:30pm, and extended day runs until 5pm.

source.title: FUN Summer Camps for Children Ages 4-14

warnings: Page shows the Summer 2026 season (June 15-September 4, 2026), which has already passed; 2027 details not yet published.
No prices shown on this page other than a $50 per camp week deposit to save a spot.
Session entry is the overall season span; individual weekly sessions are on the registration page.
Page cites Massachusetts Department of Public Health regulations although this location is in Warwick, RI; likely shared template text across Teamworks locations.
All campers must have a valid Teamworks Membership and completed paperwork.
